## 1. Setting Working Directory & Loading Libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
root.directory <- if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) && rstudioapi::isAvailable()) dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path) else getwd()

setwd(root.directory)                                   

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root.directory)

dir.create("write/figures", recursive = T, showWarnings = F)
dir.create("write/tables",  recursive = T, showWarnings = F)
dir.create("checkpoints",   recursive = T, showWarnings = F)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loading libraries
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)
library(Seurat)
```

## 2. Loading Seurat Object

```{r}
seu <- readRDS("checkpoints/seu_with_SingleR.rds")

# Checking the number of cells per cell type
table(seu$SingleR_label)
```

## 3. Creating a CellChat Object from the Seurat Object

```{r}
cellchat <- createCellChat(
  object = seu,
  group.by = "SingleR_label", # Grouping by cell type
  assay = "RNA"
)

# Checking the object information
cellchat

# 14768 genes.
# 3789 cells.

# Attaching the full human LR database (Secreted Signaling, ECM-Receptor and Cell-Cell Contact)
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.human

# subsetting the expression data of signaling genes
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)

# Inspecting available group names
levels(cellchat@idents)
```

**Cell Types:**

```         
[1] "B_cell"           "CMP"              "GMP"
[4] "HSC_-G-CSF"       "HSC_CD34+"        "Monocyte"
[7] "Myelocyte"        "Neurons"          "NK_cell"
[10] "Pre-B_cell_CD34-" "Pro-B_cell_CD34+" "Pro-Myelocyte"
[13] "T_cells"     
```

## 4. Pre-processing & Communication Inference

```{r}
# Identifying over-expressed genes and interactions
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
# The number of highly variable ligand-receptor pairs used for signaling inference is 437.

# Computing communication probability & filtering low-cell groups
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "triMean")
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)

# Inferring pathway-level communication
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

# Inspecting the signalling pathways inferred
unique(cellchat@netP$pathways)
```

**Inferred pathways:**

```         
[1] "MHC-I"         "MIF"           "CD99"
[4] "CypA"          "MHC-II"        "RESISTIN"
[7] "MK"            "GALECTIN"      "BAFF"
[10] "ICAM"          "CLEC"          "ANNEXIN"
[13] "PECAM1"        "ADGRE"         "Prostaglandin"
[16] "LCK"           "BTLA"          "SELPLG"
[19] "IL16"          "PECAM2"        "BAG"
[22] "NCAM"    
```

I got this message:

The cell-cell communication related with the following cell groups are
excluded due to the few number of cells: CMP, GMP, HSC\_-G-CSF,
HSC_CD34+, Myelocyte, Neurons, Pro-B_cell_CD34+, Pro-Myelocyte ! 76.7%
interactions are removed!

## 5. Network Centrality

```{r}
# Computing the network centrality scores
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")
```

## 6. Visualizations

In most of the upcoming plots `remove.isolate = T` is used to remove the
low-cell groups that were filtered out with `filterCommunication()` from
the plot.

### 6.1 Circle plot

```{r}
# Interaction number circle plot
png("write/figures/circle_num_interactions.png",
    width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)

netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  weight.scale = T,
  label.edge = F,
  title.name = "Number of interactions",
  remove.isolate = T
)

dev.off()

# Interaction weights circle plot
png("write/figures/circle_weight_interactions.png",
    width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)

netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$weight,
  weight.scale = T,
  label.edge = F,
  title.name = "Interaction weights",
  remove.isolate = T
)

dev.off()
```

### 6.2 Heatmaps of interaction count and weight

```{r}
# Interaction number heatmap
ht1 <- netVisual_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  remove.isolate = T
)

# Interaction weights heatmap
ht2 <- netVisual_heatmap(
  cellchat,
  measure = "weight",
  remove.isolate = T
)

combined_ht <- ht1 + ht2

png("write/figures/heatmaps_interaction_count_weight.png",
    width  = 3000, height = 2000, res = 300)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(combined_ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")

# close the device so the PNG is actually written to disk
dev.off()
```

### 6.3 Signaling Role: Sending vs. Receiving Scatter Plot

```{r}
netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")

ggsave("write/figures/signaling_role_scatter.png",
       width  = 15,
       height = 10
)
```

### 6.4 Circle Plot (MIF & GALECTIN Pathways)

```{r}
# MIF pathway
png("write/figures/circle_MIF.png",
    width = 2000,
    height = 2000,
    res = 300
)

netVisual_aggregate(
  cellchat,
  signaling      = "MIF",
  layout         = "circle",
  edge.width.max = 10,
  signaling.name = "MIF",
  remove.isolate = T
)

dev.off()

# GALECTIN pathway
png("write/figures/circle_GALECTIN.png",
    width = 2000,
    height = 2000,
    res = 300
)

netVisual_aggregate(
  cellchat,
  signaling      = "GALECTIN",
  layout         = "circle",
  edge.width.max = 10,
  signaling.name = "GALECTIN",
  remove.isolate = T
)

dev.off()
```

### 6.5 Bubble Plots (T-Cells, MIF & GALECTIN)

```{r}
# Showing signals from T cells to all groups
netVisual_bubble(cellchat,
                 sources.use = "T_cells",
                 angle.x = 45)

ggsave("write/figures/bubble_T_Cells.png",
       width  = 7,
       height = 10,
)

# Showing all the significant interactions (L-R pairs) associated with the MIF pathway
netVisual_bubble(cellchat,
                 signaling = "MIF",
                 remove.isolate = T)

ggsave("write/figures/bubble_MIF.png",
       width  = 7,
       height = 10,
)

# Showing all the significant interactions (L-R pairs) associated with the GALECTIN pathway
netVisual_bubble(cellchat,
                 signaling = "GALECTIN",
                 remove.isolate = T)

ggsave("write/figures/bubble_GALECTIN.png",
       width  = 7,
       height = 10,
)
```

### 6.6 Gene Expression Violin Plot (MIF & GALECTIN Pathway Genes)

```{r}
# MIF pathway
plotGeneExpression(cellchat,
                   signaling = "MIF",
                   colors.ggplot = T,
                   type = "violin"
)

ggsave("write/figures/Gene_Expression_Violin_MIF.png",
       width = 15,
       height = 10
)

# GALECTIN pathway
plotGeneExpression(cellchat,
                   signaling = "GALECTIN",
                   colors.ggplot = T,
                   type = "violin"
)

ggsave("write/figures/Gene_Expression_Violin_GALECTIN.png",
       width = 15,
       height = 10
)
```

## 7. Exporting Results

```{r}
# CellChat object
saveRDS(cellchat, file = "cellchat.rds")

# Pathway Network dataframe
net.df <- subsetCommunication(cellchat)

write.csv(net.df, "write/tables/CellChat_edges.csv", row.names = F)
```
